text.title: Architectural Impact PR Ranking — Output Contract
text.summary: The weekly report is one JSON document with one section per rule in 01-core-rules.xml: a header with window, repositories, session time-box, the published weights over the five named signals and last week's precision; a ranked list whose signals come from the diff with line counts and read estimates that fit the session; a deferred list; exclusion counts that reconcile to the population; a merged-without-review section that is never omitted; and the per-repo public API path list. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: from / to timestamps over which PRs opened or merged were scanned (r-window-repos-exclusions-stated)
every repo scanned, each with has_public_api_list and, when true, the committed config path (r-public-api-surface-enumerated-per-repo)
slot, time_box_minutes (45 by default), top_n and the summed read estimate of the ranked list (r-top-n-fits-the-session)
one number per signal: modules_touched, public_api_delta, dependency_changes, contract_changes, infra_or_config_changes (r-score-formula-published-in-report)
new_dependency, major_bump, minor_bump, patch_bump, removal, lockfile_only (0) (r-dependency-change-weighted-by-kind)
true: no title, label, author or description term enters the score (r-signals-from-diff-not-metadata)
top N with rank, pr, score, the five signal values, changed_lines, read_minutes and outcome hit / miss / pending (r-score-formula-published-in-report, r-precision-recorded-per-session)
PRs above the review threshold the session cannot fit, with their scores; empty when none (r-top-n-fits-the-session)
count excluded by bot_authors, reverts, docs_only, generated_files; population_total reconciles (r-window-repos-exclusions-stated)
PRs above threshold merged before the session, with score, merged_at and merged_by; an empty list is printed, never omitted (r-merged-without-review-flagged)
last session's hits over n, or null for the first report (r-precision-recorded-per-session)
required when weights_changed is true: previous weights and at least four weeks of recorded precision (r-precision-recorded-per-session)
URLs: the ranker run, the public API path configs, the previous report

forbidden.pattern: signals_from_diff_only false, or a scorer that reads title, body, labels or author (fm-title-driven-score)
dependency_kind_weights.lockfile_only above 0, or patch_bump at or above new_dependency or major_bump (fm-bot-bumps-on-top)
a repository with has_public_api_list false whose PRs carry a non-zero public_api_delta (fm-undefined-public-api)
session.summed_read_minutes above time_box_minutes, or a ranked PR without changed_lines and read_minutes (fm-top-n-exceeds-session)
merged_without_review absent, or a window filter on state = open (fm-merged-before-session-invisible)
weights_changed true with fewer than four precision weeks cited, or ranked PRs from the previous report without hit / miss marks (fm-weights-tuned-by-feel)
ranked + deferred + every exclusion count not equal to population_total

allowed-transformations.transformation: Where a repo has no committed public API path list, print "no API surface list" for it and score public_api_delta as 0 rather than guessing from file names.
Collapse a stack of dependent PRs into one ranked entry whose pr field lists them, with signals computed over the combined diff.
Round read_minutes to whole minutes; the estimate is for fitting the session, not for billing.

list.item: The header prints window, repositories, time-box, top N, the five weights and last week's precision; a reader can recompute every score from the printed signals.
signals_from_diff_only is true and no title, label, author or description term is in the scorer.
Every repo either has a committed public API path list or is scored 0 on public_api_delta with "no API surface list" printed.
dependency_kind_weights put a new dependency and a major bump above any patch bump; lockfile-only churn is 0.
summed_read_minutes of the ranked list is at or under time_box_minutes; everything above threshold that does not fit is in deferred.
ranked + deferred + bot_authors + reverts + docs_only + generated_files + below_threshold equals population_total.
merged_without_review is present, even when empty, and every entry names the merger.
Every ranked PR from the previous report carries hit or miss; weights change only with four weeks of precision cited.
